desc: Count frequency of each character in s (array of size 26).
For each target frequency k from 0 to max frequency, compute minimum operations to make all counts equal k.
For fixed k, iterate letters a to z tracking surplus from increments: if count + surplus > k, delete excess or carry forward as increments; if less, insert or use surplus.
Implement helper to compute cost for given k efficiently (O(26) per k).
Return minimum cost across all k values.
Implement final code: frequency count + per-k two-state DP over 26 letters (active/inactive) with adjacent-transfer savings min(supply_prev, demand_cur); answer = min over k in 1..maxc and n.

Verify solution on edge cases: all same char (expect 0), all z's (expect 0), z-excess with y-deficit (no backward transfer), absent middle letters with distance-2 transfer (tie with delete+insert), and brute-force cross-check on small random strings.
